problem: Read rso/ensorain/challenge/REPORT.md in full. The central defect (s4.1): K1 and K2 compare a subject to its OWN frozen / shuffled configuration, so the verdict depends on the INNATE value of the plastic parameter (jitter: a non-learner reads REVISION_NOT_HISTORY_DEPENDENT; learns_pre: a genuine lifetime learner on the post-switch side reads REVISION_NOT_SHOWN). Required, pre-outcome, as a VERSIONED amendment (v1.1.0: the arms/controls change, so not wording-only), committed before the re-freeze: (1) wording narrowings of s1 and the s5 table (REPORT s4.1-4.3); (2) a K1 comparator that is invariant to the innate start. Pallas proposes a noise-matched arm (plasticity on, eta -> 0) or K1 against both. COORDINATOR SUGGESTION, yours to accept or reject with reasons: a WHOLE-LIFE joint endpoint (a life counts as revised iff its pre-switch AND late-window role-1 counts are both majority-correct), compared full vs frozen and full vs noise-matched -- no fixed-sign policy, on either side, can satisfy both halves, so the contrast stops depending on where theta starts; check it on jitter, learns_pre, innate_zero, innate_max, clock_hybrid (rso/ensorain/challenge/subjects_c.py) on DEVELOPMENT seeds before freezing; (3) register jitter (must not be REVISION_*) and learns_pre (must be REVISION_*) as qualification controls (Q-d, Q-e), and optionally the no-switch descriptive arm (P2); (4) behavioural tests that kill Pallas's surviving edits E1 (Holm), E2 (G_PRE arm), E3 (window), E4 (control assignment), E6 (threshold), each RED on its mutant applied verbatim from challenge/edits.json, plus np.isfinite for P1; (5) G_R5 threshold given a competence meaning (B3), not a chance-1/2 k_pos; (6) family S declared from genome structure BEFORE the run as the subjects with a non-empty plastic key set (3), the five parameter-free subjects reported, not tested; per-subject frozen / shuffle / comparator late accuracies printed beside every verdict. Recompute N / power if the endpoint changes. Then re-freeze (FROZEN.json v1.1.0) and update ONBOARDING.md (repair-round lines, what the challenge taught). NO confirmatory run.
